title: Late-Charge Minimum and the Client's Late-Charge History on Other Invoices — Contingency Placement Agreements
content:
**Billing standard.** For a late charge on a past-due fee invoice of an agreement under the Contingency Placement Agreements, how the percentage charge and the tier's late-charge minimum combine depends on the late charges booked on the agreement's other invoices in the 12 months before the handling date:

- where 2 or more were booked, the charge is the percentage charge plus the minimum;
- where none was booked, the charge is the percentage charge alone, with no minimum;
- where exactly one was booked, the charge is the greater of the percentage charge and the minimum.

**What is counted.** Late-charge entries in the agreement's client money history tied to any invoice of the agreement other than the invoice being charged, with a date in the 12 months before the handling date. Late charges on the invoice being charged are not counted. A window of a number of months before a date covers the dates after the same day that number of months earlier, up to and including that date.

**Percentage charge.** The unpaid amount of the invoice multiplied by its monthly late-charge rate.

## Combination table

| Late charges on the agreement's other invoices, 12 months before the handling date | Charge |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | percentage charge plus the minimum |
| exactly 1 | the greater of the percentage charge and the minimum |
| none | percentage charge alone |

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

Percentage charge 3.00 USD; tier minimum 5.00 USD.

| Other-invoice late charges | Charge |
|---|---|
| 3 | 3.00 USD plus 5.00 USD: 8.00 USD |
| 1 | the greater of 3.00 USD and 5.00 USD: 5.00 USD |
| 0 | 3.00 USD |

Percentage charge 24.75 USD; tier minimum 5.00 USD: with 2 other-invoice late charges the charge is 29.75 USD; with 1 it is 24.75 USD; with none it is 24.75 USD.

On a tier whose minimum is 0.00 USD, all three rows give the percentage charge.
